verdict.rationale: The self-hosting docs list 'prompt engineering' as a core LangSmith capability alongside observability and evaluation, and link to a prompts hub, so some prompt-iteration feature exists. Nothing in the evidence describes a playground, running prompts against real models, or filling in template variables. missing for 10: documented interactive playground, execution against real model providers, template variable support, side-by-side prompt iteration/comparison, independent or hands-on corroboration.
